paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Average overall performance 0.90\% of all LLMs across both KGDS patterns. The stratification is divided into three levels: Tier-1 (OP_{avg} [61, 69]), Tier-2 (OP_{avg} [53, 56]), and Tier-3 (OP_{avg} [29, 37]).

model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates the average performance (%) of various large language models (LLMs) across both knowledge-grounded discussion summarization (KGDS) patterns, as described in the paper. The vertical axis represents "Average Performance (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The horizontal axis displays ten distinct LLMs, each represented by a single vertical bar with a unique color and labeled with its exact performance value at the top. The bars are arranged from left to right in descending order of performance, starting with the highest at 68.66% (dark green) and ending with the lowest at 29.44% (light blue). The performance values range from 29.44% to 68.66%, with intermediate values including 61.11%, 66.41%, 62.98%, 65.77%, 55.69%, 55.00%, 55.30%, and 52.61%. According to the caption, the models are stratified into three tiers based on their average performance: Tier-1 (OP_avg [61, 69]), which includes models with performance between 61% and 69% (e.g., 68.66%, 66.41%, 65.77%, 62.98%, 61.11%); Tier-2 (OP_avg [53, 56]), which includes models with performance between 53% and 56% (e.g., 55.69%, 55.00%, 55.30%); and Tier-3 (OP_avg [29, 37]), which includes models with performance between 29% and 37% (e.g., 29.44%, 36.62%). The chart visually emphasizes the performance distribution across models, with no additional annotations or emphasis on specific bars.
